newsitem.title: UK: UK RPIX goal set to avoid deflationary bias-source.
newsitem.headline: UK RPIX goal set to avoid deflationary bias-source.

text.p: Adjustments to the British government's inflation target, announced on Thursday, are aimed at avoiding a deflationary bias to monetary policy, a Treasury source told Reuters.
"We want to avoid a deflationary bias. It is easy to deflate an economy," the source said.
"We also wanted to send the signal that low inflation is better than high inflation. Price stability and predictability are desirable," he said.

The source said the government considered changing the targeted measure from RPIX -- which measures retail prices excluding home loan payments -- to another measure such as the European Union's harmonised inflation gauge, but decided against it.
